name: Codify a customer-side SaaS playbook from written guidelines

brief.objective: Codify Harborlight's vendor-contract guidelines into a reusable SaaS/MSA playbook for customer-side review.

notes: Expect all 15 default families. Liability cap, carve-outs, IP/training and renewal positions must mirror the guidelines (12 months / 6 months + USD 250,000 floor / never below 3 months; no training on customer data; 30-day notice). Families the guidelines are silent on (insurance, warranties) must be labelled as baseline for attorney confirmation, not presented as the client's position.
